title: Close and lock a quarter
summary: How to finish a quarter in order and lock it, so its figures never change after the BAS is done.

steps.text: Click Reports, then Close the last quarter. Four steps are listed, each saying whether it is done.

image.description: Close July to September 2026 with sample data: every bank line reviewed is done, the bank accounts are not reconciled yet, the BAS worksheet figures are shown, and Lock July to September 2026 is at the bottom.

steps.text: Post any bank lines still waiting in To review for the quarter.
Reconcile each bank account to the quarter's last day, from the Bank page.
Check the BAS worksheet, and do the BAS with your accountant.
Click Lock, tick The BAS for this quarter is done, and click Lock again.

sections.heading: After locking
paragraphs: Nothing dated in the quarter can be added, changed or deleted, and its reports always show the same figures. Locked transactions say Locked. A lock cannot be undone: a correction found later is entered in the next quarter.
